output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
output.explanation: Product category revenue is computed at line level, since category lives on the product and revenue is line net_amount. Only lines of completed orders (fct_orders.is_revenue = true) are included, over the full 2024-2025 period. Shipping fees are excluded because they are not in net_amount. Results are sorted highest first with a rank column.
